_comment_record_hz: Section H's mandatory high-risk list: "Mandatory for the highest-risk segments: S01+S02 (opening), S04 (tournament), X02 (build), X01 (controller/menu stress), CB-06 + CB-07 + Warden (representative combat), every band handoff +/-60 s (region transitions), X05 (save/load), S10 (finale)." This segment is on that list, so its baseline is 0.5 Hz rather than the 0.1 Hz journey default. Set by the Gate F coordinator, not a transcription choice. Cost is measured, not assumed: one readback+encode at 1920x1080 is 126.5 ms mean on this container, which at 0.5 Hz amortises to 1.054 ms/frame -- over the ~1 ms/frame line section 3 asks about. Section H requires the density here anyway; the overhead note carries the number so a reader can see what the density cost rather than being told it was free.

_comment: Transcribed from ralph/GATE_F_MASTER_PROTOCOL.md section B (span), section D (RT-12 and RT-13's post-win walk-back), section E.1 (CB-06, whose combat camera must be verified at battle start for every stronghold fight), section E.5 (objectives `defeat_the_warden`, `shut_down_the_machine`, `settle_the_roster`, `see_what_changed`), section E.6.15 (backtrack across story transitions), section G (GF-13-FINALE-01..05, GF-14-COMBAT-06) and section H (S10 is one of the mandatory 0.5 Hz continuous-evidence segments).
_comment_warden_coordinate: AMBIGUITY: section E.1 CB-06 gives warden_aldis as (90.2,7569.4), which is exactly what data/config/bands/band5_stronghold_approach/trainers.json says. data/config/stronghold.json puts the `warden_arena` chamber at offset (0,90.2) from site.at (0,7560) -- that is (0,7650.2). The two numbers look like the same pair transposed. The protocol's own coordinate is used below, and the discrepancy is recorded rather than silently corrected.
_comment_walkback: Section D's RT-13 is 'post-win S10 walk-back to the healed meadow | as played', and section L.5 asks for 'healed ground, lights out, patrols withdrawn, NPC acknowledgment, Grandpa's post-win line'. Grandpa is 7.6 km south of the Hall, so the walk-back below is the longest leg in the run. It is walked, not shortcut: section 0.6 forbids sourcing any claim from a teleport, and 'the world responds to that victory' is the chapter's whole payoff.

steps.title: how this segment is entered

args.text: Section B: this segment's entry save is `S09-exit`. The three steps below are the handoff's own mechanics: the live save directory is emptied first so the title's Load list has exactly one non-empty slot and auto-focuses it (`title_screen.gd` focuses the FIRST non-empty slot), then slot 4 is seeded from the run directory, then the load is driven through the production title-screen Load path by synthetic input. Section B names the seed and the Load path; the wipe is not named there and is recorded here as an added mechanical step, needed because an autosave left in slot 0 would take the auto-focus and the segment would load the wrong state.
